name: Banner
author: Erin Carter
description: A single long swallow-tailed pennant hangs alone in an empty near-black field. A tapering cloth silhouette, pinned at the hoist, ripples under a travelling wind-wave that grows toward the free tail; sheen slides along the crests, hue drifts down its length, and a soft glowing ring emblem rides the surface, shearing and brightening as each wave passes beneath it.

params.label: Wind speed
params.effect: Speed of the travelling wave along the pennant, from a barely-stirring hang to a brisk steady flutter.

params.label: Banner span
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of the pennant from hoist to tip, scaling the whole object from a small accent to a frame-crossing streamer.

params.label: Emblem glow
params.effect: Brightness of the glowing emblem riding the cloth; at 0 the pennant is lit by sheen alone.
